technology_name: Raw Banana and Cereal-Based Instant Drink Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
description: Processes for the development of raw banana and cereal instant drinks. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains up to 70-80% starch, processed using size reduction devices, milling, boiling, and drying equipment to create functional health foods.
applications: Manufacturing of low-glycemic powdered instant beverage mixes, Production of RTD (Ready-to-Drink) therapeutic health drinks, Processing of value-added grain-and-fruit functional beverages ,Formulation of specialized clinical health nutrition powders
